scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @apc/server" "npm run dev --workspace @apc/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @apc/server && npm run build --workspace @apc/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @apc/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @apc/web
